articles.title: The U.S. Just Bet $1 Billion on Quantum Chip Manufacturing
articles.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce has finalized a CHIPS and Science Act R&D award of up to $1 billion for Anderon, a quantum foundry IBM established earlier this year. The 16 September announcement backs a manufacturing service for IBM and other quantum-hardware developers. IBM is matching the award with $1 billion in cash and contributing intellectual property, assets, and skilled workers.
